notes: Seed URL redirects to www.browncountytx.gov. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). For each target election the posted unofficial file is a scanned Hart-style 'Cumulative Results Report ... Unofficial Results' (county totals; read visually, no text layer). Precinct numbers appear only in official files ('PCT nnn DEM/REP 05.26.2026', 'OFFICIAL RESULTS 05.26.2026' precinct by precinct, 'PRECINCT 1-4 OFFICIAL RESULTS' for the primary); no precinct-level file is posted for the 2024 general. The 2024 unofficial file is linked under the mislabeled title '2024 Write-In Ballot Certification-'. Runoff unofficial file printed 8:14 PM and uploaded 8:38 PM CDT on election night; the primary unofficial file was printed 8:45 PM but uploaded 1:35 PM CST Mar 4; the 2024 file printed 9:42 PM Nov 5 but uploaded Nov 12 (its scan CreationDate 8:45 PM CST precedes the printed run time, so the scanner clock is unreliable).
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER (county totals only; precinct numbers only in official reports or never posted), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence low because only the runoff has both printed and upload times on election night.

2024_general.fact: Link titled '2024 Write-In Ballot Certification-' = scanned 'Cumulative Results Report BROWN COUNTY, TEXAS Unofficial Results 2024 November 5th General Election GENERAL ELECTION 11/5/2024 Run Time 9:42 PM Run Date 11/05/2024 Precincts Reporting 18 of 18' (county totals); Last-Modified Tue, 12 Nov 2024 22:05:59 GMT. No 2024 general precinct-level results posted.

2026_primary.fact: 'ELECTION DAY UNOFFICIAL RESULTS 03.03.2026' = scanned 'Cumulative Results Report BROWN COUNTY, TEXAS Unofficial Results 2026 March Primary Election PRIMARY ELECTION 3/3/2026 Run Time 8:45 PM Run Date 03/03/2026' (county totals); Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 19:35:55 GMT. 2026_runoff.fact: 'UNOFFICIAL RESULTS 05.26.2026' = scanned 'Cumulative Results Report BROWN COUNTY, TEXAS Unofficial Results 2026 May 26, 2026 PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION 5/26/2026 Run Time 8:14 PM Run Date 05/26/2026' (county totals); Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 01:38:50 GMT.
